summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $191,475 unsecured promissory note issued to sponsor HWei Super Speed Co. Ltd. to fund a trust-account extension for its initial business combination. The note is non-interest-bearing, matures upon closing, and is forgiven if no deal occurs. The sponsor waived trust-account claims and can convert principal into units at $10.00 per unit. This is a routine SPAC extension financing, not a special situation. What to watch: upcoming business-combination deadline and potential liquidation if no deal.
